description.describe_ch: This course is designed to develop public speaking skills . Public speaking is a vital soft skill - be it used in the classroom or for a presentation at work . Attention will also be given to individual communication activities designed to improve the ability to organize , reason tically , and to listen effectively . Each student will develop and deliver several speeches and participate in peer evaluations.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. Be on time. 請準時上課。
2. Participate in class discussion and class activities. 請參與課堂討論及課堂活動。 
3. Students must submit a leave application to the school in advance, stating the reason for the leave and the expected duration.學生必須提前向學校提交請假申請，說明請假的原因和預計時間。
4. Please purchase original textbook, following intellectual property law. 請購買正版課本，請勿使用複製版本。
5. The texts and exercises will be completed in class. Please bring textbooks to class. 請上課攜帶課本，以利上課活動使用。
6. Follow the school rules to apply for a make-up exam within three days of the exam date. Relevant documents are required for the application. No-shows or those with late application will receive ZERO. The date of a make-up exam will be arranged by the instructor. 若須要補考的同學，請遵照學校的補考規定，在考試後的3天內提出申請。若考試當天沒有出現或者是沒有申請補考的同學，考試成績一律0分。
7. Following the FCU Exam Regulations, cheaters will receive ZERO for their exams and such cases will be reviewed by the Student Reward and Disciplinary Committee. 考試請遵照考場規定，若作弊者以0分計算，並移請學生獎懲委員會議處。

gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
1.	Respect: You are encouraged to attend class regularly and participate in class activities, but don’t monopolize conversations. Disrespectful comments or behavior will not be tolerated. Please contact me immediately if you ever feel like the class atmosphere is not respectful toward you or your peers. On speech day, kindly remember to listen at the classroom door before entering. Never, never, never enter the classroom while a student or guest is speaking. Don’t ever sleep in class, either. Please respect each other and your instructor.
2.	Technology: Phones must be put away during class. Tablet or laptop computers may be used for class-related material and note-taking. I may change this policy if computers become distracting,
3.	Attendance: Attendance is counted from the first week. Please be aware that skipping classes will jeopardize your overall course grade. Also, sleeping in class is regarded as an absence. 
4.	Missed Speeches/ Late assignments: No late or makeup work will not be accepted unless in the event of a documented emergency.
5.	Academic Integrity: Proper citation of sources is required. Copying or using others' work (including AI tools) without full acknowledge is considered plagiarism.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
1.	Attend class regularly and participate in class activities actively.
2.	No use of cell phones during class. 
3.	Missed Speeches/ Late assignments will not be accepted unless in the event of a documented emergency.
5.	Proper citation of sources is required. Copying or using  AI completed works without full acknowledge is considered plagiarism.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
綜合說明
  1. Students must exhibit honesty and ethical behavior in their academic activities, avoiding plagiarism and falsification of data. 學生在學術活動中必須展現誠實和道德行為，避免抄襲和篡改資料。 
  2. Plagiarism: Proper citation of sources is required. Copying or using others' work without appropriate attribution is considered plagiarism. 抄襲：必須適當引用來源，未經適當標示使用他人作品屬於抄襲行為。
  3. Cheating: Following exam rules is mandatory. Unauthorized materials or collusion with others during exams is considered cheating. 考試作弊：必須遵守考試規則，禁止使用未經授權的材料或與他人串通作弊。
